description: This PHP source file defines the class PoDatabaseWriter, which implements the PoWriterInterface for handling Gettext PO files within Drupal's locale module. It manages writing translations to the database, including setting headers, options, and importing strings with safety checks.

classes.name: PoDatabaseWriter
classes.description: A class that writes Gettext PO data into Drupal's locale database, handling options, headers, and string import logic.
